notes.title: June Downtime & Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/9d792df043a79a08a23f6d7d4378e56e0ee1542f.png[/img] [h2]VEGA CONFLICT'S 9TH ANNIVERSARY[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/730ab085e9c6e198a18a8624d6cae212b5dc5503.png[/img] VEGA Conflict was released on June 7th, 2013 making 2022 the 9th anniversary of the game! KIXEYE is very thankful for all of the fantastic art, strategy, and teamwork that VEGA has fostered over the years. This includes the thousands of players that spend each day making VEGA Conflict a part of their lives. We appreciate all you do to make the community a place that helps each other, as well as gives feedback on what you want to see in the game.So as a thank you, Rebel, log in on [b]June 7th[/b] to receive a very special gift as a token of our gratitude for making VEGA Conflict what it is today. [b] [/b] [b]For 9 Years of VEGA, let's celebrate![/b] (Must log in each day to receive the gift. All players active in the last year, qualify. Gifts will not be credited, replaced, or swapped.) [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/766bdd41af6801d38e3debc2b9f131a1b825c660.png[/img][h2]HAMMER TIME[/h2] You have the Anvil to [u]battle the battle things.[/u] Now complete your set with the tools of the master craftsman, the HAMMER. Designed to be powerful, hard-hitting, and the embodiment of destruction.[u]The [b]Hammer[/b] is the Retrocitor's equivalent to a Battleship, bristling with weaponry, and known as a Warship. [/u]Much like Battleships, Warships are the gunships of a fleet, equipped with a devastating arsenal. Warships are unable to target multiple ships on their own, utilizing a single large firing arc, but are also more durable and agile. [b]The Hammer comes down June 9th in [/b][b][u]Complicity[/u][/b][b] [/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/43a4c4d112b12bc155042bb203b04295475b3e40.png[/img]  The Hammer is the Retrocitor’s equivalent to a Battleship, bristling with weaponry. Able to strike at targets all around it, the Hammer is more agile than its Battleship counterparts [h2][b]Link Torpedo[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/623911470162519a50ccb68a1c6860f6b3d3affe.png[/img]  The [b]Link Torpedo[/b] is a high-velocity torpedo, using its momentum to punch through its target and chain into multiple enemies, using Explosive damage.  [h2]Net Squadron[/h2]The [b]Net Squadron[/b] is a modified salvage collection unit, originally designed to hook up energy tow cables to salvage, now weaponized to deal damage to enemies.  [h2][b]Burst Thruster[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/f3c7f0569df1fe0e74dbdeb05218c9e5ca889c67.png[/img]  The Burst Thruster does what the name implies and provides a short boost to the forward speed and acceleration of ships allowing them to close in on enemies. However, the boost only lasts for a brief period.  [h2]Experimental Salvage Set 5[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/58d40f74969dded27c6581a6b4b821ac6201a0ae.png[/img] [table][tr][td][b] Name[/b][/td][td]Shield Regenerator[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Description[/b][/td][td]While equipped, the hull gets a boost to its shield recharge.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flaw[/b][/td][td]However, the Power needed to recharge means a reduced amount of shield energy overall.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Shield Energy Reduction[/b][/td][td]–25%[/td][/tr][/table]   [table][tr][td][b]Name[/b][/td][td]Modified Targeting System[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Description[/b][/td][td]While equipped, the hull can target multiple enemy hulls within its firing arc(s)[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flaw[/b][b][/b][b][/b][/td][td]Though able to track multiple hulls, the system is finicky, at best, and can be overwhelmed by large numbers of ships, causing it to lose range for a period of time.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Trigger Value[/b][/td][td]4[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Range Reduction[/b][/td][td]-30%[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]DPS Increase[/b][/td][td]+50%[/td][/tr][/table]  [table][tr][td][b]Name[/b][/td][td]Field Extender - Carrier[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Description[/b][/td][td]While equipped, the Carrier’s field range is increased.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flaw[/b][/td][td]In order to extend the range of the field power is drawn from the Shields.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Shield Energy[/b][/td][td]-100%[/td][/tr][/table] [h2]Barony Duke Carrier Flagship[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/d48b18c92c717aec8f0b2594426b1681ffa6f042.png[/img]  The NPC Carrier, the Duke, is a new hull being developed for the NPC faction, The Barony. This ship is the Carrier/Flagship of the Barony faction. It features Hangar slots for offensive prowess, giving it a long-range 360-degree firing arc. It provides support bonuses to allied Barony hulls in its vicinity, as well as provide offensive support in the form of long-range weaponry and drones, as well as shutting down enemy hulls that wander into it’s range.    [h2]Weapon Specials[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/d9e77ebdbeb0a13e9be032e6a3b3431434ed2c3b.png[/img][list][*]Known for pushing the limits, the Retrocitors developed the [b]Superheated Rounds [/b]to increase the damage Kinetic weapons deal to heavily armored hulls by dangerously exposing the core of the munitions. Use this special when dealing with high health enemies, or with hit and run hulls to wear enemies down.[/*][*] The [b]Overload Conductors[/b] was designed to help Energy Retrocitor weapons overload enemy shields and get damage past them. Use this special when dealing with enemies with high Shields to punch through their defenses.[/*][*] The [b]Rapid Launchers [/b]was created to help deliver the ordinance of Explosive Retrocitor weapons to their targets faster. Use this special when dealing with faster moving ships or any swarms of ships you need to take out quickly.[/*][/list]

[h2] [/h2] [h2]Base Fields[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/2a93cc5e263289f8aaf2f51d341d6917d8f134dd.png[/img]  Each field provides a boost to it's respective defenses. Boost your modules and customize your base to combat invading forces. [b]Absorption Field[/b] - Energy [b]Obdurate Field[/b] - Kinetic [b]Ignition Field[/b] - Explosive  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/ab92eabe27c16791fe2a5b6a7ac1a42d78864499.png[/img] RETROGRADE Begins: Thursday, June 2nd @ 3PM PDT Ends: Monday, June 6th @ 3PM PDT JUNE MAIN EVENT Begins: Thursday, June 9th @ 3PM PDT Ends: Monday, June 13th @ 3PM PDT MOBILIZATION Begins: Thursday, June 16th @ 3PM PDT Ends: Monday, June 20th @ 3PM PDT *20% Ship Build Discount (24 hours) DECIMATION Begins: Thursday, June 23rd @ 3PM PDT Ends: Monday, June 27th @ 3PM PDT *20% Ship Refit Discount (24 hours) ALLIANCE WAR Begins: Monday, June 27th @ 3PM PDT Ends: Thursday, June 30th @ 3PM PDT RETROGRADE Begins: Thursday, June 30th @ 3PM PDT Ends: Monday, July 4th @ 3PM PDT [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/3b2b3093c5f23454f4649cffdbc094557f4634d2.png[/img][list] [*]ECHO Resistor - Stat-block scrolling interface on mobile[/*] [*]iOS fuzzy base visuals[/*] [*]Charged Hull ES components no longer reduces Resistances[/*] [*]Executor and Inheritor Fleet level issue resolved[/*][/list] [h2]Data Changes:[/h2][list] [*]Energy Booster ES component’s flaw has been changed to a -75% range reduction instead of -100%[/*] [*]Health, DPS, and Range of T11 Squadrons has been increased.[/*] [*]Tri Resistance added to the MK I and MK II levels of the Reclaimed Plates.[/*][/list]

It will be active for the first 24 hours of the event for builds started after the discount begins. [b][i]Starts Thursday, May 19th, 2022 at 3pm PST.[/i][/b]

[b][Hull] Anvil Carrier [/b]

	The Anvil was originally used as a mobile salvage and repair platform, hauling the crews and tools needed to complete long recovery operations. Now it has been refitted to act as a Carrier, deploying squadrons to attack while supporting nearby hulls.


[b][Tech] Retrocitor EN/EX/KI Resistors[/b]

	The Resistors provide hull resistance against select damage type in addition to counter-tech for different weapon behaviors


[b][Tech] Momentum Thruster[/b]

	The Momentum Thruster was designed by the Retrocitors to provide a powerful thruster system that focuses on hull handling. It also takes the momentum energy gained from sharp turns and converts it into shield energy.


[b][Tech] Breach Squadrons[/b]

	The Breach Squadron is a modified salvage collection unit, originally designed to set explosive charges and seperate pieces of salvage to break them into smaller pieces, now weaponized to blast apart enemies.


[b][Commander] Khalin Hullwright[/b]

	Kahlin still has his Root implant and it has allowed him to access the weapons systems of Retrocitor ships under his control, improved the performance of any Vulcan based weaponry equipped to them as well as improved the Shield energy of his fleet. He uses his ship building knowledge to help the Retrocitors escape from, and take the fight to, the Astral Barony.

notes.title: February Downtime & Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/f997f41fb30d5c5e52ec8b9f732b94b38a4325f3.png[/img]
[h1]VEGA CONFLICT IS UNDERGOING DOWNTIME 
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 2nd @ 10AM PDT (Est. 2 hr)[/h1]


Rebels, 
This month is the start of Tier 11 and some interesting new content. Participate in monthly events to earn the new tech brought by the Retrocitors, as well as learn why they are here and what they are running away from. 

[h2]RETROCITOR SCRAPPER[/h2]
[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/mdibROChH4hLYAnsLwS1U_nlBqUshDQ_A7g02B2uQkDF7EtXqmeLBgtmpIpoz8HziejdC6-vfUhNvC7DdPIZdXkIU5jt4vNcUn1mzqmwsyULLAUJquLZes7nMvGAb6wd3eWXXaEw[/img]



 

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/x62dOIR83gu8Ugiybje6iaJkgWm4cnYekU_IX6cpEe-AkFDUxXjcjbOPqjnynzXhBdpuH9EY-NIigH-_ILbH8H1Q9yy7ZImHg2mHcS8RweL4epCiAheuvXZxwm3yI_kvb1LZ9nhv[/img]


[b][Deception] [/b]Join the Retrocitors in their battle against these mysterious invading forces. Earn the first Tier 11 ship, the Scrapper, and try out the Experimental Salvage to find the best combination for your play style. 


[b][Mobilization][/b] Earn the Scrapper MK III - MK IV upgrades while earning a top spot on the leaderboards! 


[b][Alliance War][/b] Alliance War is a hybrid PVP/PVE event where Alliances fight with other Alliances for control over Mining Outpost in a special Unstable Sector to earn Intel and Solar Shards that they use to purchase prizes and unlock additional tiers or prizes in the event store respectively.


[b][Decimation][/b]  Attack targets to complete the Retrocitor Scrapper Elite and grab the Reclaimed Armor, Reclaimed Shields, or Diversiform Missiles you might have missed. 




[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/alyLJ5Jwfj50464wRERUdxnONG6Eop9mygnOajHqTprhtmGhV0iOwgpTrbGYpfKR0Evv022rK26uPRNdcfab1mPOGjoxjE5O8bX_Z6_ugQWMeKYSl6CSYrkXcq_j7V98l2Wzjvkt[/img]


[b][Scrapper][/b]

The first Tier 11 hull, the Scrapper, is a fighter class hull that will feature strong defenses and above-average damage output.  This will be the first hull with an Experimental Salvage slot and two items to choose from. 





[b][Experimental Salvage] [/b]

The Experimental Salvage mechanic is the new defining mechanic for Tier 11. You will be able to choose from a selection of components to equip to ships for custom gameplay.



[b][Reclaimed Shield] [/b]

The Reclaimed Shield is manufactured from scavenged technology. While its shield energy output is at a high level, it lacks the resistances of other shields, instead able to offer high resistance to a single type.



[b][Reclaimed Armor][/b]

The first hull armor in the Retrocitors faction and provides Armor Health and Explosive Resistance to start.





[b][Diversiform Missile] [/b]



The Diversiform Missile appears to fire a single projectile missile, but upon detonation splits into 2, and then splits again into 3. In addition to covering the enemy with multiple projectiles, there is a small AoE to help against swarms.


[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/Sx1hAM15IaXh2E7x_huIkEnwqaO65ul8odwnhjTHwKzeMHv0o0gF03JtyejTUaJXjoDR9YEGH-0O9AL3hjuewiQGPg3nE13pZyeGBM2SQlKmBZxW46hLlWMrlzfJAObUVVuq-5Fd[/img]

[b][Campaign] [/b]These time-limited missions are being repurposed to help set up lore and provide additional activities for those that want more combat. These campaigns will not only give you context to VEGA events, but will also give you a step up in Tier 11 with relevant prizes.



[img]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/kOPbOXhW5GzyxoqsSCKxkictYxLsd3iK2SF7B3z9ZcrlVXmWrPWWPSJUwX4UNNRBpD957opeq-mrNVJ-NFyvNpb3h5HKDu-5IswqVa_jm7inPZYT_AueeB0ntIc6f5O7RXlmhGr_[/img]

A9 no longer gives a Spectre Resistance but instead boosts Charge Time and Drain Rate for Prime Shift.

notes.title: December Update & Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]VEGA CONFLICT IS UNDERGOING DOWNTIME[/h1][h1]WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 1ST @ 10AM PDT (Est. 1.5 hr)[/h1]

Rebels,

Our forecasting radar has detected prolonged, severe magnetic activity in select sectors of space. Keres seems to be behind it, but the charged particles interfere with our predictive instruments. Tread lightly as your instruments will likely be affected as well. Grab the Optio hull to use Liberatus tech against them, disrupting opposing systems in battle. 

[h2][b]SPECTRE OPTIO[/b][/h2]
[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/5uhqLNnzeqUPpufNh_GSlLtQWQGy1CKNfA-PagVEI4ehG8TKVH3sPDVcUTPIrKfGecf8Nfdt74uTVNBVOYLOmsqAh4ydwdFnCQcL5SlEkEJlC2D3Ul5-XCz-drS_AIu1UEREf09N[/img]


[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/TxwVC61LB7GC5si1ZpVuXuNt0QGUCxKaQV-ZrS55drtMHOzPSGjxV0ZocTiniyvIihzqmZANWbrk6s2ubV-Ske3BctqQXvFP9OEGA1Bhfp6nTT57MLmh2aTKUVBs0EdkYoZl27Zy[/img]


[b][ION STORM][/b] WARNING: A large magnetic storm is brewing. The magnetically charged sectors feature Liberatus targets dropping plans for the Optio hull. Brave the high energy particles to earn the Lustre Cannon III and Ilos Missile III. Forecasting is predicting the storm on Thursday, December 9th at 3pm PDT.

[b][Mobilization][/b] Liberatus Ameliorate targets hold the pieces you need to upgrade your Spectre Optio II-IV. Don’t forget the Hacksaw Vulcan Turret III fragments are waiting for you in the Hone targets! It starts Thursday, December 16th, at 3pm PDT.

[b][Decimation] [/b] Shut down the top Ameliorate to collect the pieces to complete your Spectre Optio Elite! The new Hiberna targets will grant the previously unavailable Spectre Boosed Dissipators Type C. All in Decimation starting  December 29th, at 3pm PDT.

	

[b][Solstice] [/b]Once again, we will reenact the Norwalien's narrow escape from a collision with a Red Giant. Join in the Snowball Fight Thursday December 23rd, at 3pm PDT.



[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/sWNhqTtc_OkMFGvVvVe5L5L-uaS5FPWYdY6xEuT-MTxwIgDLwKziMCh6ipa9NzkC49tmtXQaF0P6BtQLnUzMdEqHI3QHKuDcFsNR7Q_sqbHhdOkYx1RBs3J8CuIKObxDWzXkv5T8[/img]


[b][OPTIO][/b] A Debuffer designated hull is adept at spreading various status effects amongst enemies opening them up for more damage. A Debuffer features stronger defenses at the cost of offensive prowess. Debilitate and Shield Disruption

[b][LUSTRE CANNON][/b] A new Energy weapon has been developed to aid the Optio in combating spawned hulls and other enemies in close proximity. The Lustre Cannon uses ricochet projectiles to damage and debuff multiple enemies.

[b][ILIOS MISSILE][/b] The Ilios Missile uses a single, guided missile to deal lots of damage in a large area. The Ilios was developed as an offensive option for tier 10 Carriers, and can only be equipped to these hulls.




[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/pZ_DJu0hZQIgdRAeDps-BwBcePxcOgzK9oMAnr4CJqhXXAOCQNDv3H5rFiRrJgKBM4UcSTXyZjhQPzhAyzxPsTkbTxUbgJxGqHJ0dEhl7PZa5di-NmQC7bbbXko2Zr5LPPnEq9MM[/img]

notes.title: Modulator: Two Ships In One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11173373/5def1e427f2212c28b19883f91a637d481ed78f7.png[/img]
[h1][b]VEGA CONFLICT IS UNDERGOING DOWNTIME[/b][/h1][h1][b]WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 3RD @ 10AM PDT (Est. 1 hr)[/b][/h1]

Rebels,

Now is the time to bolster your base defenses with the newest Spectre technology in Dissipators and Base Specials. This month, you will be able to control enemy swarms with the Modulator hull and Hacksaw Vulcan, as well as charge up your Spectre fleets with the Spectre Fleet Commander, Annie.
[h2]

Rebels,

In this release, look out for new content including the Spectre Warbird, Tracker Torpedo, Carbyne Armors, and Hangar Wings. [*] [b][WARBIRD] [/b]The Spectre Warbird is the quintessential battleship, featuring area of denial capabilities including dual firing arcs (one on side of the hull) and allows for ample weapon loadout flexibility thanks to its 8 weapon slots. Independently of its Prime Shift state, upon losing its shields it fires a single projectile which splinters into three projectiles, which in turn, splinters into five additional projectiles.
[*] [b][TRACKER TORPEDO][/b] Using explosive damage along with AoE, the Tracker Torpedo brings the best of battleships into a single weapon - as the name suggests, it uses guided shots to help ensure it reaches its target accurately.
[*] [b][CARBYNE ARMOR][/b] Using a more effective health to mass ratio than previous armors, Carbyne Armors are the latest in Tier 10 defenses, providing not only a boost to Prime Shift charging, but also grants 50% resistance against Energy, Explosive, and Kinetic Damage at level 3.
[*] [b][SENTRIES][/b] The Shelling Sentry, Electro Sentry, and Pyro Sentry are included in this release and are planned to be introduced throughout the coming months. First is the Pyro Sentry, then keep an eye out for the Electro Sentry and Shelling Sentry in the coming months.
[*] [b][HANGAR WINGS][/b] Electron Wings, Scorch Wings, and Dart Wings will become available over the next few months in a similar pattern to Base Sentries: Electron Wings become available first through the Flame Strike event and Mobilization, then look out for the Scorch Wings and Dart Wings in the future.
[/list]

On Tuesday, September 21st, we completed a hotfix which capped Liberatus Resistance at 50% due to the Executor not taking any hull damage whatsoever using certain equipment loadouts. It was later discovered the most recent high level targets can be destroyed for free repairs, which was unintended. After further testing, it was deemed necessary to further reduce the amount of Liberatus Resistance to 30%. This change will be active directly after the server update.

notes.title: A Look at 2017 and Beyond!
notes.content:
[i]Greetings Rebels![/i]

Wanted to take the opportunity to catch the Community up on all things VEGA Conflict, including a look at what the rest of 2017 and beyond has in store! Let’s dive in!


[u][b]VEGA Conflict in China[/b][/u]

We’ve been working to release a localized version of VEGA Conflict in China that will exist separately from the global branch of VEGA Conflict, and will start back from the relative beginning of the game. Right now this version of the game is gearing up for launch by doing some Marketing pushes, and part of that includes one or two pieces of early game content that will be exclusive to that version of the game. This is similar to what we did with the Nexus Destroyer when we launched on Android back in the day, and is what the Soul Battleship announcement I made was in reference to.

Players in China can still play in the global branch of VEGA Conflict from Steam if they choose - and the steps for linking to Steam are available here on KIXEYE.com under Support.


[u][b]Tier 6 Season Finale[/b][/u]

June will mark the conclusion of the Tier 6 season, and the defining aspects of this finale that I’m personally looking forward to are Ship X and the new Geir’s Fortress target!


[i]Ship X (Suppressor Specialist)[/i]

The Specialist is a new catch-all class for our future Ship X hulls. Ship X, you’ll remember, is our rule-breaker hull. They are not restricted to a specific firing arc or existing class type, and moving forward the design of these ships will be centered around their capacity to solve a specific strategic ‘problem’.

The Suppressor Specialist is a modification of stolen Alien Reaper designs, with a 360 degree firing arc (similar to a Corvette). The human armor plating and the Alien engine design that hasn’t been mastered by human technology means it’s not quite as fast as Alien Reapers, but it’s still agile and will keep up with nearly all fleet types.

Its defining feature is a massive boost to damage against Squadrons and Swarms (+75% to damage against Squadrons/Swarms, which increases with each Mk upgrade). Coupled with the Seeker Missile, which features an outrageously high fire rate, the Suppressor becomes a key hull for closing the distance to any targets that launch squadrons or swarms of any kind, and ensuring that your fleet isn’t racking up damage along the way.


[i]Geir’s Fortress[/i]

The final showdown with Geir has arrived. The infection has entirely consumed him, and he’s more alien now than human. The June event will feature an Alien Outpost boss target where he and his elite guard reside, labeled Geir’s Fortress. This is the most difficult target we’ve ever had in VEGA Conflict, and only exists at level 100 for now. Only the best of the best will be able to destroy this target, and we will be tracking victories against this base closely. Whomever destroys the most Geir’s Fortress targets will be receiving a Community Spotlight, a special forum title, and a VEGA Conflict merch bag sent directly to them from me.



[u][b]Introducing The A.X.I.S. Project[/b][/u]

In July, the Tier 6.5 season will begin and will occupy the remainder of 2017. We’ve traveled to Alien-owned sectors and seen what their power can unleash, in turn we’ve hit their first wave forces with a tremendous amount of devastation. This hasn’t gone unnoticed. Backup is beginning to arrive, and the Alien targets you’re familiar with will now begin to contain more battle-hardened veterans of the Alien forces. Heavy-duty ships that deploy strategies the VEGA sectors have not yet seen. We’ve certainly gotten their attention and they’re beginning to push back.

The Rebellion recognizes the need to strike while the Aliens are attempting to regroup. We are now the invading force, and no mercy can be shown if we expect to survive in this era of the Unknown threat. However, as Geir is no longer...in healthy enough condition, let’s say...to continue running the Xeno Division and providing anti-Alien tech, our Rebel Engineers have taken it upon themselves to get us what we need.

They call it Advanced Xeno Integrated Systems, or colloquially ‘The A.X.I.S. Project’. Advanced versions of the Xeno designs, completely owned and operated by the Rebel Faction and available to the pilots who earn them through victory in combat. No more taking what Geir hands out to us - the Rebellion is the master of its own destiny now.

But the A.X.I.S. Project is more than just ships and tech. The Engineers in charge of this project are overhauling existing systems to speed up every aspect of life in the Void. Such projects they’re hoping to release sometime during the 6.5 season include:

[i]Time Tokens[/i]: one-time use tokens that immediately reduce the length of various projects, be it repairs, refits, or builds.

[i]Harmonics[/i]: Certain tech will come with baked in Harmonics frequencies. Use tech with the same harmonics frequencies to receive additional buffs beyond their stats. The whole is greater than the sum of its parts, Rebels!

[i]Tier 1-5 construction time overhau[/i]l: implementation time to be determined, but our engineers think they can find a way to bring the build time of this tech down significantly.

[i]Sector Repairs[/i]: no need to return home to repair or drop off the resources you’re hauling. Instantly repair from outside your base and continue on your way.

[i]Social and Friends[/i]: Be able to find and relocate to friends in-game regardless of what platform you’re playing on. Mark individual players as friends and foes, separate to your Alliance diplomacy.



[u][b]A New Era of PvP[/b][/u]

In the immediate future, Civil War will be getting a refresh. New prizes for more relevant content, and the likely addition of a shared human sector where more battle can take place. Details to come closer to the release of the first refreshed Civil War.

There’s also word from the outer reaches of the Void that a group of marauders have been stealing hull and weapon blueprints from all known factions, repurposing them for PvP raids. As with most space pirates, these guys are pretty easy to push around, and we’ve already started taking some of this repurposed tech for ourselves. We expect to have it ready for Rebel use later in the year, and this PvP-focused tech will continue on separately from any seasonal faction that appears, with drastically lower build times to keep up with the immediacy of PvP combat!


Thanks for reading - we’re all incredibly excited about what the remainder of this year has in store and can’t wait to enjoy this ride with you all!


- CM Chris

Players in China can still play in the global branch of VEGA Conflict from Steam if they choose - and the steps for linking to Steam are available here on KIXEYE.com under Support.


[u][b]Tier 6 Season Finale[/b][/u]

June will mark the conclusion of the Tier 6 season, and the defining aspects of this finale that I’m personally looking forward to are Ship X and the new Geir’s Fortress target!


[i]Ship X (Suppressor Specialist)[/i]

The Specialist is a new catch-all class for our future Ship X hulls. Ship X, you’ll remember, is our rule-breaker hull. They are not restricted to a specific firing arc or existing class type, and moving forward the design of these ships will be centered around their capacity to solve a specific strategic ‘problem’.

The Suppressor Specialist is a modification of stolen Alien Reaper designs, with a 360 degree firing arc (similar to a Corvette). The human armor plating and the Alien engine design that hasn’t been mastered by human technology means it’s not quite as fast as Alien Reapers, but it’s still agile and will keep up with nearly all fleet types.

Its defining feature is a massive boost to damage against Squadrons and Swarms (+75% to damage against Squadrons/Swarms, which increases with each Mk upgrade). Coupled with the Seeker Missile, which features an outrageously high fire rate, the Suppressor becomes a key hull for closing the distance to any targets that launch squadrons or swarms of any kind, and ensuring that your fleet isn’t racking up damage along the way.


[i]Geir’s Fortress[/i]

The final showdown with Geir has arrived. The infection has entirely consumed him, and he’s more alien now than human. The June event will feature an Alien Outpost boss target where he and his elite guard reside, labeled Geir’s Fortress. This is the most difficult target we’ve ever had in VEGA Conflict, and only exists at level 100 for now. Only the best of the best will be able to destroy this target, and we will be tracking victories against this base closely. Whomever destroys the most Geir’s Fortress targets will be receiving a Community Spotlight, a special forum title, and a VEGA Conflict merch bag sent directly to them from me.



[u][b]Introducing The A.X.I.S. Project[/b][/u]

In July, the Tier 6.5 season will begin and will occupy the remainder of 2017. We’ve traveled to Alien-owned sectors and seen what their power can unleash, in turn we’ve hit their first wave forces with a tremendous amount of devastation. This hasn’t gone unnoticed. Backup is beginning to arrive, and the Alien targets you’re familiar with will now begin to contain more battle-hardened veterans of the Alien forces. Heavy-duty ships that deploy strategies the VEGA sectors have not yet seen. We’ve certainly gotten their attention and they’re beginning to push back.

The Rebellion recognizes the need to strike while the Aliens are attempting to regroup. We are now the invading force, and no mercy can be shown if we expect to survive in this era of the Unknown threat. However, as Geir is no longer...in healthy enough condition, let’s say...to continue running the Xeno Division and providing anti-Alien tech, our Rebel Engineers have taken it upon themselves to get us what we need.

They call it Advanced Xeno Integrated Systems, or colloquially ‘The A.X.I.S. Project’. Advanced versions of the Xeno designs, completely owned and operated by the Rebel Faction and available to the pilots who earn them through victory in combat. No more taking what Geir hands out to us - the Rebellion is the master of its own destiny now.

But the A.X.I.S. Project is more than just ships and tech. The Engineers in charge of this project are overhauling existing systems to speed up every aspect of life in the Void. Such projects they’re hoping to release sometime during the 6.5 season include:

[i]Time Tokens[/i]: one-time use tokens that immediately reduce the length of various projects, be it repairs, refits, or builds.

[i]Harmonics[/i]: Certain tech will come with baked in Harmonics frequencies. Use tech with the same harmonics frequencies to receive additional buffs beyond their stats. The whole is greater than the sum of its parts, Rebels!

[i]Tier 1-5 construction time overhau[/i]l: implementation time to be determined, but our engineers think they can find a way to bring the build time of this tech down significantly.

[i]Sector Repairs[/i]: no need to return home to repair or drop off the resources you’re hauling. Instantly repair from outside your base and continue on your way.

[i]Social and Friends[/i]: Be able to find and relocate to friends in-game regardless of what platform you’re playing on. Mark individual players as friends and foes, separate to your Alliance diplomacy.



[u][b]A New Era of PvP[/b][/u]

In the immediate future, Civil War will be getting a refresh. New prizes for more relevant content, and the likely addition of a shared human sector where more battle can take place. Details to come closer to the release of the first refreshed Civil War.

There’s also word from the outer reaches of the Void that a group of marauders have been stealing hull and weapon blueprints from all known factions, repurposing them for PvP raids. As with most space pirates, these guys are pretty easy to push around, and we’ve already started taking some of this repurposed tech for ourselves. We expect to have it ready for Rebel use later in the year, and this PvP-focused tech will continue on separately from any seasonal faction that appears, with drastically lower build times to keep up with the immediacy of PvP combat!


Thanks for reading - we’re all incredibly excited about what the remainder of this year has in store and can’t wait to enjoy this ride with you all!


- CM Chris

notes.title: VEGA Conflict Release Notes - 4/3/17
notes.content:
Rebels!

VEGA Conflict will be going down for an update on 2017-04-03 at 9PM Pacific Time. We expect this update to last 2 hours.


This release will include the following features, bug fixes, and tunings:

- Fixed assortment of minor graphical issues

- Fixed issue where notifications kept turning back on once switched off

- Fixed issue where EXAL Heavy Talonite Armor doesn’t show in BP inventory UI.

- Fixed issue where notifications deployed at original build time completion and not the reduced build time completion when players receive Alliance Help.

- Updated XP values for T6 Hulls and Equipment, so all Xeno Division ships - including the Punisher Cruiser - should start at Level 70 (Please note: the fleet level will not automatically update. Removing and adding a ship to a fleet will cause the fleet level to update).

- Added crafting recipes for upgrading Swarms

- Recipes must be researched in Arms Lab before they can be used in Workshop

- Added crafting recipes for T6 Core Fusion and Flagship Armament Fusion.
Recipes must be researched in the Ship Lab before they can be used in Workshop

- Functionality added to Mobile to view and select player fleets that are hidden by being stacked (press and hold top fleet to view all stacked objects and select which one you want).

- Ionized Optics made more potent (removed under-the-hood armor damage penalty)

- Brimstone Weapon ranges updated to accurately reflect their explosion distance

- Brimstone Torpedo (ship version) - max range of 3000m

- Brimstone Torpedo Turret (base version) - max range of 5,040m

- Cluster Missile changes (affects all versions of the Cluster Missile)

- Deviation reduced to 20% from 40%

- Firing pattern is changed - now fires 5 projectiles over a very short burst (0.15 seconds) with a 1.85 second cooldown

- Xeno Munitions changes

- Deviation reduced from -10% to -25% (Xeno Munitions I) and -20% to -50% (Xeno Munitions II)

- Shield Bypass added at +25% and 30% for levels I and II, respectively

Changes to Free-for-all level gating:

- Free-for-all ship gating is now level 55

- Free-for-all base gating is now level 45

- Added support for April monthly event

- Added support for Updated Alien Reaper Targets

- Added support for Xeno Battleship

- Added support for Rupture Beam (Energy Weapon BP)

- Added support for Heavy Rupture Beam (Energy Weapon RI)

- Added support for Xeno Rupture Beam (Energy weapon BP)

- Added support for Beam Capacitor (Energy Special BP)

- Added support for Xeno Beam Capacitor (Alien Special BP)

- Added support for EN Heavy Talonite Armor (Energy Armor RI)

- Added support for ENAL Heavy Talonite Armor (Energy/Alien Armor BP)


Notes

-- A blueprint called “Supersonic Thrusters” will be visible in your Blueprint Inventory following the update. Due to early feedback we received, the release of this Blueprint has been delayed. The stats you see are likely not final.
-- All new tech is Xeno Division only.
-- Graphical changes, stat block changes, the Swarm crafting recipes, the Flagship Armament Crafting recipes, and the T6 Core Fusion crafting recipes will not be seen on mobile until you update your version of the game.

notes.title: [Civil War] Prepare for War on 01/07
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11173373/8005713e0c29229af563a5ef1aa2db39077c11e8.jpg[/img]
Rebels, the time for Civil War is upon us! Here are the details:

IN GAME LEADERBOARDS:

There are three leaderboards: Personal, Alliance and Sector.

Personal leaderboard is your own score. This is the total number of points you have accumulated during the Civil War. At the end of the Civil War, you will be ranked against all other players and receive a prize.

Alliance leaderboard is the combined total of your alliance's score. At the end of the Civil War, your alliance will be ranked, and ALL members of the alliance will be awarded the appropriate rank prize.

Sector leaderboard is the combined total of all players in a specific sector. All players in the sector will receive the corresponding prize.

All leaderboards have their own prizes. These prizes are not mutually exclusive: For example, it is possible to place top of the Sector leaderboard (thus winning the first place prize for sector) and rank 40th on the personal leaderboard (thus winning the prize for rank 31st - 80th.)

POINTS:

This Civil War will continue to use the new points calculation. Points are calculated based on damage dealt to your opponent. The winner of the battle will receive a 20% bonus to their points earned. Bonuses will also be available to both players if it is the first battle between the two in a certain span of time. Successive hits between players will result in lowered points rewards. FvB attacks will follow a similar points calculation, but damage will be worth significantly less since bases can contain much higher HP values than player fleets.

PRIZES:

Coins will be awarded to the top 2,200 ranked players on the Personal Leaderboard. Check the in-game dialog for the complete list of prizes. This Civil War includes new and returning crafting materials: Hellfire Pattern Boxes and, ISC pattern Boxes (personal leaderboard), T5 cores (Alliance Leaderboard), and DC Armaments on the Sector Leaderboard. Reusable Items available in this Civil War are the Boosted Gladius Driver, Repeating Polaron Ray, Brutal Hydra Missile, and Precise Gauss Driver.

THE RULES FOR THIS CIVIL WAR ARE:

Player vs Player only

Fleet vs Fleet and Fleet vs Base targets are allowed

Other sectors only

Sector relocation and alliance membership will be locked IMMEDIATELY when the Civil War starts and will remain locked for the duration of the event (24 hours)

BONUS:

There will be a 25% ship repair time discount during Civil War.

Now go and make your sector proud.

CIVIL WAR
STARTS: 3:00PM PACIFIC SATURDAY JANUARY 7
ENDS: 3:00PM PACIFIC SUNDAY JANUARY 8

notes.content:

[h1]IN GAME LEADERBOARDS:[/h1]

Alliance leaderboard is the combined total of your alliance's score. At the end of the Civil War, your alliance will be ranked, and ALL members of the alliance will be awarded the appropriate rank prize.

Sector leaderboard is the combined total of all players in a specific sector. All players in the sector will receive the corresponding prize.
